reviews.review:
A nice little game, a bit on the simple side mechanically but it does what I think it sets out to do. It plays kinda like one of those puzzles where you have to move across a pattern without ever stepping in the same square more than once, except if it was a turnbased deckbuilder. The artstyle is really cool and the design of the enemies and player characters are really good. The 3 playable characters seem to have a surprisingly unique playstyle compared to one another, although you can pretty easily force a certain build every run in my admittedly limited experience with the game.

Even without a tutorial I had no problems understanding how to play the game, and the tooltips did a good job of providing information, although there maybe could be a description on the card itself when picking it of what a buff or debuff does, instead of having to hover over the icon on a character that has the effect applied to it, and a little description that most buffs tick down one every move you make, but that is minor stuff.

All in all i think a very competent title for the asking price and if you're into little puzzly games and deckbuilders I can only recommend it.
